privacy.title: Assistant Privacy
privacy.label: Hide my opinions from other members' assistant
privacy.description: When this is on, the assistant does not show your opinions to other project members who ask it. It still shows them to you. Project results, such as the mean and the number of experts, are calculated as before.
privacy.enabledToast: Your opinions are now hidden from other members' assistant
privacy.disabledToast: Other members' assistant can show your opinions again
privacy.failed: Could not save the assistant setting

panel.footer: The assistant can be wrong. Check the result page.

docs.title: Assistant
docs.intro: The assistant answers questions about the BeCoMe method and about your projects. It is an artificial intelligence system, a language model, not a person, and its answers can be wrong. Check anything important on the result page and in this documentation.

where.title: Where to find it
where.body: Sign in and click the assistant button in the top bar. On a project's result page, Explain this result opens the assistant with that project already selected.

answers.title: What it can answer
answers.method: How the method works: fuzzy opinions, the best compromise, the maximum error.
answers.project: Your project: its opinions and its result. It sees only what you see as a member of the project.
answers.app: How to use the app, for example how to create a project or invite experts. General questions work without a project too.
answers.readOnly: It only reads. It cannot change a project, an opinion or your account.

limits.title: Limits
limits.rate: You can send up to 60 messages an hour. When you reach the limit, the assistant tells you how many minutes to wait.
limits.time: An answer can take up to a minute.
limits.storage: The conversation is not saved to your account. It stays only in this browser tab.
limits.history: In a long conversation, older messages are no longer sent with new questions, so the assistant stops taking them into account.

data.title: Your data
data.sent: Your question and the data of the open project, including other members' names, positions and opinions, go to an AI model in the EU. The <privacy>Privacy notice</privacy> describes exactly what is sent and how long it is kept.
data.sensitive: Do not type sensitive data into the assistant.
data.objection: If you do not want the assistant to show your opinions to other members, turn on Hide my opinions from other members' assistant in your profile.

tour.title: Ask the assistant
tour.body: Not sure what a result or a term means? Click the assistant button <icon/> in the top bar and ask in your own words. It knows the BeCoMe method and the projects you are a member of. It is an AI and can be wrong, so check what matters on the result page.
tour.hint: More in the <docs>documentation<sr>, opens in new tab</sr></docs>, section Assistant.
